name: Akikawa Kyouichi
source: The main protagonist of Fragment's Note Side: Shizuku and Fragment's Note Side: Yukitsuki. His parents died in a plane crash when he was a child. He was then adopted into the Akikawa family, where he met his younger step sister, Akikawa Shizuku.
